# Generated context budget

<!-- generated by tooling/context_budget.py — do not hand-edit -->

What a host pays to have each skill available. `front door` is SKILL.md, read
whenever the skill is loadable. `depth` is references/, read only when the skill
opens one. `deferred` is the share of the skill held behind the front door —
higher is better, and 0.0 means everything is paid up front.

Token counts are estimates at 4 bytes/token, not a tokenizer result.
